variables.name: title
variables.description: A short, specific title for this report, drawn from what the workspace's sources are actually about.

variables.name: executive_summary
variables.description: A brief, high-level summary of the workspace's contents and purpose, written for a reader who won't read the rest of the report.

variables.name: key_findings
variables.description: The most important, evidence-backed findings across the workspace's sources, as a short list or short paragraphs.

variables.name: conclusion
variables.description: An overall conclusion synthesizing the key findings, without introducing any claim the findings didn't already establish.
